HRHB.description: Secure the Croat heartland. No army-wide override — local commanders secure their sectors.
HRHB.name: Consolidate Herzegovina

HRHB.description: No bilateral war — focus on defending Croat territory against RS. Maintain alliance with RBiH.
HRHB.name: Anti-RS Defense

HRHB.description: Post-Washington Agreement. Cease offensive ops against RBiH, defend territory, cooperate with ARBiH against VRS. Counter-attacks and probing permitted against RS.
HRHB.name: Washington Pivot

RBiH.description: Preserve forces. No offensive operations. Hold what you can, reorganize TO into brigades.
RBiH.name: Survival Defense

RBiH.description: Corps forming. Local counterattacks permitted to reclaim lost territory. No general offensives.
RBiH.name: Local Counterattacks

RBiH.description: Corps structure mature. Active defense with counterattack capability.
RBiH.name: Corps Reorganization

RBiH.description: Pinprick attacks begin. Probe VRS lines, test weaknesses, stretch reserves. Not breakthroughs.
RBiH.name: Active Defense

RBiH.description: Full counteroffensives. Corps-level coordinated operations (1994-1995 campaigns).
RBiH.name: Controlled Counteroffensive

RS.description: Exploit JNA equipment handover for maximum territorial gain before international response.
RS.name: Territorial Seizure

RS.description: Consolidate gains, targeted operations on strategic objectives. Tempo constrained by supply, fatigue, and overstretch — not by standing order.
RS.name: Targeted Operations
